Name: Keg and Fiber Seeds Recipes for sale
Author: JinxWild19
Description:
My mother and I have been playing different [url=https://lunanjinx.com/]challenges[/url]. We thought it seemed silly that we didn't get these recipes sooner. So now you can buy them!
Well, once you meet certain conditions.

Fiber
﻿3 hearts with Caroline
﻿3 hearts with Linus
﻿Level 3 Foraging

Keg
﻿2 Hearts with Leah
﻿Level 3 Farming
﻿Level 3 Foraging

Linus Shop
﻿2 Hearts with Linus
﻿Level 1 Foraging
﻿Linus's trash scene triggered  (can skip)

Once you meet the conditions, a letter will be sent, and a recipe or shop will be available.﻿


I also made it compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] cause I like playing with that mod. It is not required to play, but it is if you download the optional file.

More information about Linus' Shop ...
[code]﻿[spoiler]
Randomized Rotating Stock
Mixed Seeds, Fiber Seeds, Copper Ore, Gold Ore, Iron Ore, Shashimi, Wild Bait, Ruby, Jade, Emerald, Aquamarine, Amethyst, Topaz, and Diamond.

Items Linus Wants
Mon: Cactus Fruit
Tue: He is closed
Wed: Pickles
Thu: Yam (a 3% chance of dropping from [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Duggy]Duggies[/url])
Fri: Coconut
Sat: 2 Sardines
Sun: Winter Root (Blue [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Slimes]Slimes[/url] (8% chance) in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Mines]The Mines[/url] (floors 41-79) )[/spoiler]
[/code]

In the long run, my mom and I want to make a mod that will make it easier to customize the game for the challenges that we come up with. But at the moment, this is our first mod for Stardew. (Although I have done a few for myself in Minecraft -Jinx)

If you like the mod or have suggestions let me know!!! :D
